SAP identifies this El Paso County, Colorado location, in the InterQuest Ridge area on the north side of Colorado Springs, under the internal facility code COS02. SAP SE is a German enterprise software company founded in 1972 that has grown into one of the world's largest business software providers, reporting more than 110,000 employees across over 157 countries and non-IFRS revenue of 36.8 billion euros for fiscal year 2025. The company's core business is enterprise resource planning and related cloud applications for finance, procurement, human resources, supply chain, and customer engagement, delivered to customers worldwide, including through SAP Americas, which the company describes as covering more than 70 locations across North and South America.

A facility carrying an internal "COS" code naming convention in a business is typically part of a company's own operational real estate rather than a customer facing product, and Colorado Springs has for decades been home to a concentration of technology, aerospace, and telecommunications operations, including large corporate office and data campuses along the InterQuest corridor near Interstate 25, making it a plausible location for a company operated facility supporting SAP's internal computing, network, or business continuity needs in the western United States.

SAP's public corporate materials describe the company's global footprint in broad terms, such as its Labs network and Experience Centers, but do not name or describe a Colorado Springs facility, its square footage, its power capacity, or its function in any public document identified during research for this entry. That absence is itself informative: unlike Segra or Serverfarm, SAP is not in the business of marketing colocation space, so facilities like this one exist to serve the company's own operations rather than to attract tenants, and enterprise software companies of SAP's size routinely operate regional data or office facilities without public disclosure of technical specifications, treating that information as internal infrastructure detail rather than a matter of public record. No El Paso County property, permit, or zoning record specific to this address was identified during research for this entry. Absent such a record becoming available, what can be documented here is limited to the facility's general location, its operator's scale and business, and the broader technology corridor context of the InterQuest Ridge area in which it sits.
